epistemic_status.ESTABLISHED: Sufficiently supported for the decision phase under the stated perimeter and period.
epistemic_status.CONTESTED: Material counterevidence, ambiguity or disagreement remains.
epistemic_status.OPEN: The proposition or required condition has not been resolved.
epistemic_status.UNEXAMINED: The relevant perimeter has not yet been examined.

decision_status.ACCEPTED_WITH_CONDITIONS: Adopted only subject to explicit conditions or monitoring.

freshness_status.STALE: One or more material upstream bases changed and the position has not been recomputed or re-accepted.

outcome_status.PARTIALLY_HELD: The position held only in part.
outcome_status.MATERIALIZED: The risk or failure mechanism occurred.
outcome_status.RECOVERED_AFTER_FAILURE: The position failed and was later remediated.
